chronology.earliest_execution_assumption: next observed XNYS session; not used to claim trading performance

selection: all 14 frozen base market features are present
risk_volatility_next_20d is present for risk-cutoff fitting
training_role.previously_viewed_period_policy: The 2024-2025 period is not reported as blind evidence, but after Phase 7 selection is frozen it may enter the final pre-2026 training-only role. It cannot be used to alter the selected procedures.

excluded: learned estimator probabilities or rank scores
feature_contract.availability_rule: Every feature for date t uses only company and SPY observations at or before t. The 2025 overlap supplies trailing history but is not scored.

label_contract.target_window_rule: target_window_end is exactly the twentieth shared XNYS session after decision date t
label_contract.risk_outcome: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of adjusted-close simple returns t+1 through t+20, annualized by sqrt(252)

return_classes.rule: On each evaluation date, rank available future 20-session returns across eligible peers using average ties; rank <= n/3 is Lower, rank <= 2n/3 is Middle, otherwise Higher. At least 45 active and outcome peers are required.

risk_classes.cutoff_method: Pooled linear 1/3 and 2/3 quantiles from the frozen training role only; values equal to a cutoff enter the lower class.

common: ticker is one of the frozen 50 modeled companies and is not SPY
all 14 base market features are finite
target_window_end and the required continuous outcome are present
risk_additional: risk class from the frozen training-only cutoffs is available
evaluation_eligibility.matched_date_rule: Return ranking metrics use every eligible same-date peer; no stock from a date may be moved to another role.

return.name: momentum_20d
return.ordering: higher score ranks first; ticker ascending breaks an exact score tie for deterministic top-10 membership
return.interpretation: ranking control only; not an expected percentage return

risk.name: volatility_20d_with_training_cutoffs
risk.score: sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of the latest 20 adjusted-close simple returns ending at t, annualized by sqrt(252)
risk.class_mapping: Apply the two frozen training-only risk cutoffs to trailing volatility_20d
risk.fit: risk cutoffs only; no learned estimator
risk.interpretation: future price-risk class control; not a Shariah compliance score

secondary: daily top-10 minus universe return values
future-return and relative-class distributions for descriptive audit
per-class precision recall F1 and support
High outcomes predicted Low rate using High outcomes as denominator
confusion_matrix with class order Low Medium High
risk.probability_metrics: not applicable because the selected procedure emits hard classes and no probabilities; log loss and Brier score must not be fabricated

shared: eligible and excluded row counts with exclusion reasons

decision_and_failure_rules: Score the reserved period once after Step 8.3 validation passes.
Publish every declared metric even when unfavorable or undefined.
Do not tune, replace, recalibrate, or add a feature, cutoff, model, metric, or date after any 2026 outcome is inspected.
Do not invent a post-hoc performance threshold. Phase 8 is a final research estimate, not another selection round.
If construction or eligibility differs from this contract, stop before scoring and version a corrected contract while outcomes remain uninspected.
If the result motivates a changed procedure, label this reserved result as evidence for the old procedure and require a different future period for the changed procedure.
Do not claim trading, portfolio, Shariah-compliance, or whole-market performance from this evaluation.
phase9_gate: Phase 9 may package the frozen benchmark procedures only after the Phase 8 dataset and one-time evaluation reproduce exactly. Proceeding does not imply strong predictive performance; unfavorable results must remain visible.
